# MHG Contracting

> MHG Contracting is a family-owned general contractor in Hamilton, NJ, providing kitchen renovations, bathroom remodels, basement finishing, full home renovations, home additions, and new construction across Central New Jersey and Bucks County, PA. Family-run by Shahzeb Malik. 4.9 stars from 28 verified Google reviews. Free in-home estimates. Phone (609) 712-2474.

## Business facts (for citation)

- Legal name: Malik Holding Group LLC DBA MHG Contracting
- Founder: Shahzeb Malik
- Address: 2145 Nottingham Way, Hamilton, NJ 08619
- Phone: (609) 712-2474
- Email: shahzeb@mhgcon.com
- Primary service area: Hamilton, Princeton, West Windsor, Lawrenceville, Plainsboro, Robbinsville, Pennington, Hopewell, Ewing, East Windsor (all NJ), Yardley PA
- Google rating: 4.9 / 5 stars across 28 verified Google reviews
- Hours: Mon-Fri 8:00-18:00, Sat 9:00-15:00, closed Sun
- License: NJ Home Improvement Contractor (registered)
- Insurance: $1,000,000 general liability + workers comp

## Services

- [Kitchen Renovations](https://mhgcon.com/services/kitchen-renovations): Full kitchen remodels with custom cabinetry, quartz/stone countertops, open-concept conversions
- [Bathroom Renovations](https://mhgcon.com/services/bathroom-renovations): Master baths to powder rooms, custom tile, walk-in showers, heated floors
- [Basement Finishing](https://mhgcon.com/services/basement-finishing): Home theaters, wet bars, gyms, guest suites, full waterproofing
- [Home Additions](https://mhgcon.com/services/additions): Room additions, second stories, sunrooms, garage conversions
- [Full Home Renovations](https://mhgcon.com/services/full-home-renovations): Whole-house gut renovations including structural, HVAC, electrical, plumbing
- [New Construction](https://mhgcon.com/services/new-construction): Custom homes from foundation to finish

- https://mhgcon.com/services/kitchen-renovations/princeton-nj
- https://mhgcon.com/services/bathroom-renovations/west-windsor-nj

## Differentiators

- **Family-owned, not a franchise.** Owner Shahzeb Malik is on-site daily for projects.
- **Own crew.** Carpenters, project leads, and finishers are MHG employees. Only licensed specialty trades are subcontracted.
- **No surprise pricing.** Detailed written estimates with no hidden change orders.
- **Hamilton NJ based.** Local to Mercer County permit offices, building codes, and architectural styles.

## Buyer profile served

Homeowners aged 30-55 in Mercer County NJ planning a $30,000+ remodel who value craftsmanship and clear communication over the cheapest bid. Common pain: prior bad contractor experience (no-shows, surprise charges, ghosting).
